title: Scheme: batch-settlement on Solana (SVM)
notes: Read at commit f8f8330 on 2026-10-19. Added in PR #2698, merged 2026-08-21. After the payer's request_close and the withdrawDelay grace period (900 to 2,592,000 seconds), anyone can call seal, and the payer recovers unspent escrow through withdraw_payer or a sealed distribute.
